guides.concept: 剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學單元1的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm
教學單元2的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm；y=khard/ksoft=4 1
教學單元3的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k1=20 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm, L=20 m；y=(k2-k1)/L=2 kN/mm/m
教學單元4的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：ds=12 mm, L=15 m；y=ds/L=0.8 mm/m
教學單元5的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa；y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm
教學單元6的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=0.0001 m/s, A=2 m2, i=0.05 1；y=k*A*i*1000=0.01 litre/s
factsEn: Teaching unit 1 baseline scale: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm.
Teaching unit 2 baseline scale: Original assumed example, not field operating values: khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm; y=khard/ksoft=4 1.
Teaching unit 3 baseline scale: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k1=20 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm, L=20 m; y=(k2-k1)/L=2 kN/mm/m.
Teaching unit 4 baseline scale: Original assumed example, not field operating values: ds=12 mm, L=15 m; y=ds/L=0.8 mm/m.
Teaching unit 5 baseline scale: Original assumed example, not field operating values: stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa; y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm.
Teaching unit 6 baseline scale: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=0.0001 m/s, A=2 m2, i=0.05 1; y=k*A*i*1000=0.01 litre/s.
timeline: 2006-10　運輸研究委員會發布軌道過渡段比較研究摘要。
2014-11-18　歐盟公布整合基礎設施互通規範第一二九九號法規。
2026-03-04　美國鐵路管理局發布新版軌道與構造物檢查手冊。
timelineEn: 2006-10 — TRB published its comparative research digest on track transitions.
2014-11-18 — The EU issued Regulation 1299/2014 for the infrastructure interoperability specification.
2026-03-04 — FRA issued its updated Track and Structures Compliance Manual.
codes: 歐洲基礎設施互通技術規範：依地區與適用版本核對。
軌道過渡段設計研究摘要第七十九號：比較方法指引而非通用允收門檻。
codesEn: European Infrastructure TSI: verify jurisdiction and applicable edition.
Design of Track Transitions, Digest 79: comparative methodological guidance, not universal acceptance limits.
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出軌距與限界、運輸需求、供電與號誌以及施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in gauge and clearance, service demand, power, signalling and construction methods.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：鐵路路基過渡段處理
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Railway subgrade transition treatment
guides.concept: 鐵路路基過渡段處理以「剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。路基過渡段把柔性土工支承連到較硬的橋台或涵洞，幾何高差與剛度突變會互相放大，單次起道不能消除深層沉陷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A transition connects flexible earth support to a stiffer abutment or culvert; level differences and stiffness jumps can amplify one another, and a single lifting correction cannot remove deep settlement. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
procedure: 同載重下不同支承剛度造成位移差。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.1 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩個獨立線性支承。使用兩側同步載重位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部懸空使差異增加，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
剛度比描述突變程度但不含過渡長度。本模型把 khard 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 4.4 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。相同載重區間的等效剛度。使用沿程剛度剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；同比值不同長度可有不同動態效應，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
將剛度差分散到較長距離降低平均斜率。本模型把 k1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 1.9 kN/mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。假定線性漸變。使用各里程支承剛度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部突跳可被平均斜率掩蓋，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
相同沉陷差在短距離形成更陡幾何變化。本模型把 ds 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.88 mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小坡度兩點近似。使用時序高程剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；基準下沉會混淆真實沉陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
壓縮模數把應力增量連到層厚變化。本模型把 stress 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13.2 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。一維均勻壓縮。使用應力與分層位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
排水需同時有通道與水力梯度。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.011 litre/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。飽和線性達西流。使用水頭與流量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；排水出口堵塞會保留高孔壓，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
定力下較柔支承儲存較多彈性能。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 72.6 J。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一線性彈簧。使用力位移曲線面積作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；塑性耗能不能當成可回復儲能，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
過渡長度與車速共同決定作用時間。本模型把 L 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.55 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等速通過。使用車速與過渡邊界作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；過短事件可能超出低頻量測頻寬，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
按通過總重正規化可比較觀察期。本模型把 ds 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.44 mm/MGT。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。指定觀察窗平均。使用沉陷和噸位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；首次壓密與後期成長不可同一線性外推，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
預期沉陷必須保留在調整預算內。本模型把 total 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 12.5 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同方向代數餘量。使用已用與預留調整量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
procedureEn: Different support stiffnesses create displacement differences under equal load. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.1 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Two independent linear supports. Use simultaneous load-displacement on both sides as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Stiffness ratio describes contrast but excludes transition length. In this model, khard is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 4.4 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval. Use longitudinal stiffness profile as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal ratios over different lengths have different dynamics; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Spreading stiffness contrast over longer distance reduces its mean gradient. In this model, k1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 1.9 kN/mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Assumed linear grading. Use support stiffness at each chainage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A local jump can hide within the mean slope; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Equal settlement contrast creates steeper geometry over shorter distance. In this model, ds is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.88 mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Small-slope two-point approximation. Use time-series elevation profiles as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Datum movement confounds actual settlement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Constrained modulus links stress increase to thickness change. In this model, stress is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13.2 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform one-dimensional compression. Use stress and layer movements as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Drainage requires both a flow path and a hydraulic gradient. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.011 litre/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Saturated linear Darcy flow. Use head and discharge as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Blocked outlets retain high pore pressure; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Softer support stores more elastic energy under fixed force. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 72.6 J. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One linear spring. Use area under force-displacement curve as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Plastic dissipation is not recoverable energy; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Transition length and train speed determine exposure time. In this model, L is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.55 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant-speed passage. Use speed and transition boundaries as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Short events can exceed low-bandwidth measurements; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Normalization by gross tonnage compares observation periods. In this model, ds is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.44 mm/MGT. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Mean over a specified window. Use settlement and gross tonnage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Initial compaction and later growth need different extrapolation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Expected settlement must remain in the adjustment budget. In this model, total is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 12.5 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Algebraic reserve in one direction. Use used and reserved adjustment as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
evidence: 重算「相鄰支承位移差」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩個獨立線性支承如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部懸空使差異增加造成偏離的合成觀察，以兩側同步載重位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
重算「剛度比值辨認」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出相同載重區間的等效剛度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由同比值不同長度可有不同動態效應造成偏離的合成觀察，以沿程剛度剖面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
重算「剛度漸變斜率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出假定線性漸變如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部突跳可被平均斜率掩蓋造成偏離的合成觀察，以各里程支承剛度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
重算「差異沉陷坡度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出小坡度兩點近似如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由基準下沉會混淆真實沉陷造成偏離的合成觀察，以時序高程剖面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
重算「填土壓縮量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出一維均勻壓縮如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數造成偏離的合成觀察，以應力與分層位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
evidenceEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Adjacent-support displacement difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Two independent linear supports. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch. Explain which evidence in simultaneous load-displacement on both sides distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Stiffness-ratio identification, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal ratios over different lengths have different dynamics. Explain which evidence in longitudinal stiffness profile distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Stiffness-gradient slope, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Assumed linear grading. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A local jump can hide within the mean slope. Explain which evidence in support stiffness at each chainage distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Differential-settlement slope, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Small-slope two-point approximation. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Datum movement confounds actual settlement. Explain which evidence in time-series elevation profiles distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Fill compression scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform one-dimensional compression. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus. Explain which evidence in stress and layer movements distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
pitfalls: 局部懸空使差異增加。這個失效與「相鄰支承位移差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查兩側同步載重位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
局部突跳可被平均斜率掩蓋。這個失效與「剛度漸變斜率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各里程支承剛度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數。這個失效與「填土壓縮量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查應力與分層位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
塑性耗能不能當成可回復儲能。這個失效與「支承能量比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查力位移曲線面積，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
首次壓密與後期成長不可同一線性外推。這個失效與「循環沉陷增量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查沉陷和噸位，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
pitfallsEn: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch. This failure and a measurement bias in Adjacent-support displacement difference can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check simultaneous load-displacement on both sides rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

A local jump can hide within the mean slope. This failure and a measurement bias in Stiffness-gradient slope can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support stiffness at each chainage rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus. This failure and a measurement bias in Fill compression scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check stress and layer movements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Plastic dissipation is not recoverable energy. This failure and a measurement bias in Support strain-energy comparison can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check area under force-displacement curve rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Initial compaction and later growth need different extrapolation. This failure and a measurement bias in Settlement increment per traffic can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check settlement and gross tonnage rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

related.title: 多年凍土地區鐵路路基
related.transfer: 可遷移「相鄰支承位移差」與「支承能量比較」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；多年凍土地區鐵路路基的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同；多年凍土地區鐵路路基則以凍土熱平衡活動層與路基變形為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement; Railway embankments on permafrost centres on permafrost heat balance active layer and embankment movement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「相鄰支承位移差」與「地基導熱通量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到多年凍土地區鐵路路基，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「年度淨熱收支」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Adjacent-support displacement difference” and “Ground conductive heat flux”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Railway embankments on permafrost, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Annual net heat balance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 鐵路路基過渡段處理
history.text: 本課把鐵路路基過渡段處理放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。路基過渡段把柔性土工支承連到較硬的橋台或涵洞，幾何高差與剛度突變會互相放大，單次起道不能消除深層沉陷。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Railway subgrade transition treatment in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. A transition connects flexible earth support to a stiffer abutment or culvert; level differences and stiffness jumps can amplify one another, and a single lifting correction cannot remove deep settlement. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
